item.tib: khro bo khrag 'thung mngon rol gyi 'phrin las dbu phyogs
item.coloph: dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi (gyis) mdzad/ de nas rim gyis rgyud (brgyud) nas/ mthu 'o (bo) che mi dgu la rgyud (brgyud) / rgya gar sngags bdag gi bka'/ stong rgyung mthu chen man ngag 'di/ skal ldan las 'phro cig dang 'phrad par shog 'phrad nas bstan pa srung bar shog 'dru yon sgom thar la shog ser/ bla ma mdor dbus kyis zhus so/ rgya gar bon skor gnyen po 'di/ atham/ sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya//
